name: table-with-columns
dql: TABLE file.mtime, due FROM "projects" WHERE due < date(today) SORT due DESC LIMIT 10
oqx: select path, updated_at, due from docs where (path.startsWith("/projects/") or path == "/projects.md") and date(due) < date("today") order by due desc limit 10

name: table-without-id
dql: TABLE WITHOUT ID file.link AS "Note", rating FROM "games" WHERE rating >= 8 SORT rating DESC
oqx: select path, Note: path, rating from docs where (path.startsWith("/games/") or path == "/games.md") and rating >= 8 order by rating desc

name: table-no-columns
oqx: select path from docs where path.startsWith("/inbox/") or path == "/inbox.md"

name: table-as-alias-ident
dql: TABLE due AS deadline, pages * 2 AS doubled FROM "books"
oqx: select path, deadline: due, doubled: pages * 2 from docs where path.startsWith("/books/") or path == "/books.md"

name: table-duplicate-field-names-get-generated-aliases
dql: TABLE due, due, file.mtime AS mtime, file.mtime AS mtime FROM "a"
oqx: select path, due, c1: due, mtime: updated_at, c3: updated_at from docs where path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md"

name: table-column-named-like-the-envelope
dql: TABLE file.path AS path, blockId AS id FROM "a"
oqx: select path, c0: path, blockId from docs where path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md"

name: list-with-expression
oqx: select path, value: updated_at from docs where path.startsWith("/journal/") or path == "/journal.md"

name: list-without-id
oqx: select path, value: data.title from docs where path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md"

name: task-bare
oqx: select path, id, text, checked from blocks where type == "task"

name: task-open-in-folder
oqx: select path, id, text, checked from blocks where type == "task" and (doc.path.startsWith("/work/") or doc.path == "/work.md") and !checked

name: task-due-today
oqx: select path, id, text, checked from blocks where type == "task" and !checked and date(doc.due) <= date("today")
warnings: due: a task's inline fields are not indexed per task; read as the page's property doc.due

name: task-text-contains
dql: TASK WHERE contains(text, "urgent") SORT file.mtime DESC
oqx: select path, id, text, checked from blocks where type == "task" and "urgent" in text order by doc.updated_at desc

name: calendar
oqx: select path, date: updated_at from docs where (path.startsWith("/journal/") or path == "/journal.md") and has(date)

name: calendar-field
oqx: select path, date: due from docs where status != "done" and has(date)

name: keywords-are-case-insensitive
dql: table file.mtime from "a" where due sort due desc limit 3
oqx: select path, updated_at from docs where (path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md") and due order by due desc limit 3

name: multiline
dql:
TABLE
  due,
  status
FROM "projects"
WHERE status = "open"
SORT due ASC
oqx: select path, due, status from docs where (path.startsWith("/projects/") or path == "/projects.md") and status == "open" order by due
